bio.text: Dennis Tipsword, a Republican, represents the 105th District in the Illinois House of Representatives, a seat Tipsword has held since January 2023.
According to the General Assembly biography, Tipsword is chief deputy of the Woodford County Sheriff's Office and has a 30-year law enforcement career.
The biography says Tipsword was born and raised in Woodford County, graduated from Metamora Township High School and Western Illinois University, and lives in Metamora.
